items: The Credit Guarantee Scheme for MSMEs offers government-backed collateral-free loans up to
Rs. 100 crore to promote easy access to finance for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.
o Coverage: Up to 85% for micro/small and 75% for medium enterprises.
o Eligibility: Open to registered MSMEs (new and existing).
o Purpose: Working capital, term loans, machinery, etc.
o Benefits: No collateral, reduced lender risk, and increased loan availability.
Available through participating banks and financial institutions.
